title: knowledge/preference builtin shell
description: builtin base shell (runtime domain_schemas/ override wins on same $id). Minimal structure only: preference ontology fields (scope, applies_to, decay policy) stay open; strict validation belongs to the domain's runtime schema file. Preference = a durable user/channel-level liking or disliking that should bias future behavior (recall weighting via the user domain; LLM-produced candidates stay in the governance Draft pipeline).
